However, the Topology Boundary Auditor's high confidence mask (0.989) suggests the main subject is well-defined, but the visual 'melting' of the rock background noted by the Router is a valid generative artifact common in AI images where background context fails to resolve sharply. I agree with the severity ratings; they are minor but noticeable upon close inspection.

No structural hallucinations (extra segments, asymmetric lobes) were detected.

The rock matrix edge shows slight 'smudging' or melting into the void/background, lacking the sharp physical termination expected in a macro photo. This prevents a perfect 5.0 artifact score, but the defects are peripheral and do not compromise the main subject.
